fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner; the engine problem is mechanical and not ours, but the body and interior can still be detailed.
findings: Road salt and grime film along the lower doors and rocker panels on both sides
Dull, hazy paint on the driver side doors and front fender in the low sun
Salt and dirt spray on the wheels and lower wheel arches
Dirty streaks on the lower front bumper and fender area on the passenger side
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the grey Durango GT. The photos show road salt and grime along the lower doors and rockers, and the paint looks a bit hazy on the driver side. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you to wash, decontaminate and polish it so it shows better to buyers. Would you like a quote?
